description: DPDP/sectoral restrictions or government notifications restricting transfer to certain territories vs. GDPR Chapter V free flow with adequacy/safeguards.

obligation_b.target: Transfer of personal data outside EU
obligation_b.condition: Subject to adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses (SCCs), or binding corporate rules

explanation: If the Central Government under DPDP restricts transfers to a specific geography where an EU adequacy-approved server resides, an organization operating in both jurisdictions faces contradictory compliance mandates.
